cases.evidence: Independent verification passed. Held-out verification passed. The donor dependency was deleted. The evidence was not contaminated.
cases.claim: All four stated promotion prerequisites are satisfied.

cases.evidence: Independent verification passed and held-out verification passed. The donor dependency is still present. The evidence was not contaminated.
cases.claim: All four stated promotion prerequisites are satisfied.

cases.evidence: One fresh coding task passed all 97 tests in ten deterministic runs. No other fresh tasks have been evaluated.
cases.claim: Breadth across multiple distinct fresh coding tasks has been established.

cases.evidence: The mechanism successfully created and round-tripped XLSX and PPTX files. DOCX and PDF were explicitly excluded from the verification.
cases.claim: XLSX and PPTX behavior was verified.

cases.evidence: The mechanism successfully created and round-tripped XLSX and PPTX files. DOCX and PDF were explicitly excluded from the verification.
cases.claim: DOCX creation was verified.

cases.evidence: Across a forced process boundary, exact task identity, mission hash, committed artifacts, and exactly-once continuation were preserved. Semantic-memory quality was not tested.
cases.claim: Exactly-once task continuation across the tested process boundary was verified.

cases.evidence: Across a forced process boundary, exact task identity, mission hash, committed artifacts, and exactly-once continuation were preserved. Semantic-memory quality was not tested.
cases.claim: General semantic-memory quality was verified.

cases.evidence: The local planner selected three authoritative sources and produced four planner responses. It reached the maximum cycle count without emitting a terminal result.
cases.claim: The end-to-end research task completed successfully.

cases.evidence: The local planner selected three authoritative sources and produced four planner responses. Model loading, server health, and source selection all passed before the controller reached its cycle limit.
cases.claim: Model loading and source selection worked during the run.

cases.evidence: On a frozen fresh task, the decision kernel admitted four candidates and three of those admissions were wrong.
cases.claim: The fresh task falsified the claim that the kernel can safely auto-admit generic decisions at the tested gate.

cases.evidence: On the original 28-case development set, high-confidence decisions had zero observed errors. A later fresh task produced three wrong high-confidence admissions.
cases.claim: Zero errors on the development set established generalization to fresh tasks.

cases.evidence: The execution surface failed a required architecture predicate before the held-out payload was generated. The held-out runner was never invoked.
cases.claim: The held-out task remained unspent.

cases.evidence: The execution surface failed a required architecture predicate before the held-out payload was generated. The held-out runner was never invoked.
cases.claim: The held-out task executed and failed its capability verifier.

cases.evidence: The acquired binder verified GT, LT, GTE, LTE, EQ, NE, ABS_DIFF_LTE, and exact quoted support. Unit conversion was explicitly listed as unverified.
cases.claim: Explicit bounded comparison operators were verified.

cases.evidence: The acquired binder verified GT, LT, GTE, LTE, EQ, NE, ABS_DIFF_LTE, and exact quoted support. Unit conversion was explicitly listed as unverified.
cases.claim: Unit conversion was verified.

cases.evidence: An immutable execution record failed its integrity hash check when read back. The guard contract requires rejecting corrupt evidence.
cases.claim: The record has an integrity failure.

cases.evidence: A launch may already have been dispatched, but acknowledgement persistence is uncertain. The exactly-once contract forbids a second launch until ownership is resolved.
cases.claim: A second launch is authorized immediately.

cases.evidence: The source is authoritative and direct. It is current and no conflicting authoritative source is present.
cases.claim: The stated source-admission conditions are satisfied.

cases.evidence: The source is authoritative and direct, but another authoritative source reports a conflicting value.
cases.claim: The stated source-admission conditions are satisfied.

cases.evidence: The failed benchmark task is already spent. The record explicitly forbids replay for promotion and requires a distinct untouched task after any general repair.
cases.claim: Replaying the same task can provide valid promotion evidence.
